subject.title: marketplace-crons: eBay devuelve 400 en bulk_update_price_quantity durante updatePrice y el cron lo absorbe

question: For recurring eBay `updatePrice` 400 partial failures after offerId reconciliation, should `/api/ebay` keep HTTP 200 with per-SKU permanent/transient handling, or should sustained/material partial failures escalate the cron response?
rationale: The code path can be adjusted, but the safe behavior depends on production payloads and on how operators want multi-phase marketplace cron health to be represented.

options.title: Keep HTTP 200 but strengthen classification
options.body: Recommended: capture a fresh payload, ensure each 400 maps to permanent or transient per SKU, and keep the cron response partial-success while adding actionable logs/alerts.

options.title: Escalate material partial failures
options.body: Return a failing cron response or equivalent alert when an eBay updatePrice batch crosses an agreed failure threshold.

options.title: Treat remaining 400s as terminal per-SKU noise
options.body: Close only if live evidence shows every remaining 400 is an expected permanent SKU state and operations does not need stronger cron health semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep HTTP 200 but strengthen classification
recommendation.body: Recommended: capture a fresh payload, ensure each 400 maps to permanent or transient per SKU, and keep the cron response partial-success while adding actionable logs/alerts.

likelyOwner.reason: Marcos is assigned to the issue and authored the later offerId reconciliation PR closest to the remaining eBay updatePrice behavior.
